title: KANTO >=1000 FINAL UNRESEARCHED PREFLIGHT 7
scope: Research/preflight only for the complete live Kanto >=1,000 inventory-unresearched pool. No seat transcription, source/range authoring, production implementation, generated artifact, fingerprint, or application change was made.

candidatePool.reconstructedFrom: current Kanto ledger records[]: 20 current kanto-release-critical inventory records with researchStatus not-started plus the two ledger-only Tokyo records; production, ADOPT, every existing formal disposition, RaiBoC, and chiba-port-arena-main were excluded before ranking.

ranking.method: Dedicated ticketed/live-event use, current issuer chart quality, coherent fixed/representative numbered scope, issuer structural subtotal potential, and implementation yield ranked ahead of capacity. Currentness was checked before seat-evidence conclusions; capacity was never identifier evidence.

sharedAdoptGate: Before any implementation: freshly retrieve the issuer material; freeze two independent human visual passes in different traversal order; compare the machine-expanded authored set with both frozen sets bidirectionally; reconcile issuer subtotals; perform an independent practical structural checksum; and stop production and return to the chart for any material mismatch. Machine output never generates seat IDs.

researched.identity: 横浜アリーナ
researched.currentness: ACTIVE; current issuer event calendar and seat-guide surface.
researched.seatEvidence: Issuer defines A/B/central event patterns, distinguishes event-variable 1F centre seats and standing space from numbered 2F arena, 3F box and 3F/4F stand seats, and defines their block/row/number semantics.
researched.scope: One issuer A-pattern fixed numbered seating scope only; do not create a centre-floor or standing set.
researched.implementationVerificationPlan: Apply sharedAdoptGate; re-fetch the A-pattern detail assets, preserve issuer block/row ownership, and reconcile the fixed scope against the issuer pattern before any source authoring.

researched.identity: 横浜武道館〔アリーナ〕
researched.currentness: ACTIVE; issuer presents current facility/event use.
researched.seatEvidence: Issuer publishes a granular current 2F/3F seat map with block and number detail and declares 2,436 permanent seats (2F 1,312; 3F 1,100 including 14 wheelchair spaces; 4F VIP 24). 2F is rollback and eight of twenty blocks are movable; stacking chairs are separate.
researched.scope: Issuer-published normal 2F plus 3F/4F permanent-seat chart only; neither stacking chairs nor an inferred deployment variant.
researched.implementationVerificationPlan: Apply sharedAdoptGate; explicitly classify the charted wheelchair/VIP/rollback positions and compare the summed permanent scope to 1,312 + 1,100 + 24.

researched.identity: 高崎アリーナ〔メインアリーナ〕
researched.currentness: ACTIVE issuer-managed facility; current official fixed-seat PDF link remains published.
researched.seatEvidence: Issuer declares fixed 3,021 seats (including 21 wheelchair spaces), 1,022 mobile seats and up to 1,972 temporary stands, and separately publishes the numbered fixed-seat drawing.
researched.scope: Only the complete issuer fixed-seat numbered drawing; do not add mobile chairs or temporary stands by capacity arithmetic.
researched.implementationVerificationPlan: Apply sharedAdoptGate; reconcile the authored fixed set with the 3,021 issuer subtotal and classify wheelchair marks from the drawing, not from the aggregate.

researched.scope: The current issuer-defined stadium mode only; do not mix it with the main or community modes or infer floor seating.
researched.implementationVerificationPlan: Apply sharedAdoptGate immediately before transcription and again after reopening; use only a freshly retrievable issuer stadium-mode map and stop if renovation evidence changes any seat structure.
